name: gesture-swipe-action-list
title: Gesture Swipe Action List
description: A task feed allowing rows to be swiped left for delete or right for complete with color reveal actions.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Mechanical
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Bidirectional Swipe Action: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
